new_jobs.jd: **About the Job** If you’ve gained a few years of experience in project management, planning, or operations and want to broaden your scope, this role offers the opportunity to solve problems, make sense of complex information, and learn how a business operates. You’ll research topics, analyze problems, and develop project plans, working with different teams to explore solutions, track progress, and address challenges along the way. The role goes beyond research and presentations. We’re looking for someone willing to spend time with operational teams, understand how issues arise, and help turn ideas into practical results. **Why We Have This Role** As Clinico Group marks its 40th anniversary, our businesses span eye care, hearing care, sleep medicine, biotechnology, and other healthcare fields. As these businesses grow, we’re taking on a range of projects, from exploring new markets and products to improving existing processes and bringing teams together to deliver shared goals. You don’t need to arrive with extensive healthcare knowledge or senior management experience. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, organize complex information, and proactively find the people, information, and approaches needed to move things forward. **How You’ll Find Success** You see a problem and take the initiative to work through it. When approaching an unfamiliar topic, you clarify the issue, identify information gaps, and use data analysis, interviews, and cross-functional discussions to develop practical solutions. Once a project begins, you break it down into clear tasks, identify who needs to be involved, establish timelines, anticipate obstacles, and follow through. **Things You Will Do** **1. Support CEO Office Projects** * Contribute to key group projects involving new markets, new products, operational improvements, and cross-functional collaboration. * Help define project objectives, tasks, timelines, and responsibilities. * Track progress, coordinate with stakeholders, and document outstanding issues and next steps. **2. Conduct Business Research and Data Analysis** * Gather market, industry, competitor, and operational information. * Turn data and complex information into clear reports and presentations, highlighting key findings and potential improvements. * Support preliminary research and analysis across a range of CEO Office initiatives. **3. Help Improve Operations and Processes** * Work with departments and frontline teams to understand their day-to-day workflows. * Review existing practices and identify challenges in execution. * Collaborate with relevant teams to develop and implement improved processes. * Follow up on implementation and assess whether changes deliver the intended results. **4. Support Business Management Initiatives** * Prepare information and analysis for the CEO and management team. * Document meeting highlights, key decisions, and follow-up actions. * Track important cross-functional action items. * Participate in new projects as business needs evolve. **What We’re Looking for on Your Resume** * At least 3 years of professional experience, ideally in project management, operations planning, business analysis, management consulting, PMO, strategic planning, or a related field. * A degree in business administration or a related discipline is preferred. * Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and simply. * A collaborative approach, proactive communication, and the ability to follow through and drive work to completion. * Willingness to travel as needed.

new_jobs.title: Director of Corporate Planning
new_jobs.company: Pacific Electric Wire & Cable Co. Ltd
new_jobs.jd: Serving as the strategic nerve centre and global brain of PEWC Group, this role translates the Group’s developmental vision into reality by integrating big data market analytics and forward-looking business forecasting, while employing rigorous financial and investment evaluation models. The position leads the formulation of mid- to long-term business strategies, major investments, and M&A initiatives for parent and subsidiary entities worldwide. In terms of organizational architecture, the role oversees and directs four key functional pillars: Strategy, Data, Brand Marketing, and Public Relations. While day-to-day marketing execution and PR operations are managed by respective department heads, this executive commands from an advanced strategic staff perspective—optimizing capital returns, commercial intelligence, brand equity valuation, and reputation defence architectures to maximize multinational resource synergies and long-term corporate enterprise value. What You Will Do Market Big Data Analytics & Strategic Business Intelligence * Group Mid- to Long-Term Strategy Formulation: Formulate annual operating guidelines for domestic and overseas parent/subsidiary companies, establishing a comprehensive mid- to long-term strategic blueprint for the multinational group. * Domestic & Overseas Investment Evaluation and Review: Lead feasibility studies, financial modeling, and risk assessments for global business expansion, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), joint ventures (JV), and major capital expenditures (CapEx). * Subsidiary Operational Governance & Synergy Optimization: Regularly assess KPI/OKR fulfilment and operating performance across global subsidiaries; eliminate business redundancies and drive vertical and horizontal cross-border resource integration. Brand Marketing Department Management (Global Brand Equity Elevation) * Global Brand Strategy & Positioning: Define the core brand positioning of the PEWC parent company and the extension brands of global subsidiaries, establishing brand governance standards that are globally consistent yet locally adaptable. * Domestic & Overseas Marketing Resource Coordination: Supervise integrated marketing communications (IMC) strategies across international markets, including global trade exhibitions, digital marketing, and overseas product rollout campaigns, ensuring targeted and efficient marketing budget allocation. * ESG & Sustainable Brand Management: Align brand development with green transformation trends in the wire and cable industry, spearheading the Group’s ESG sustainable brand image to enhance brand recognition and preference among international enterprise clients (e.g., global renewable energy and public infrastructure sectors). Commercial Marketing * Lead the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns aligned to commercial objectives and sales targets * Support new product launches with targeted campaigns, content, and sales enablement materials * Own the marketing contribution to pipeline, lead generation, and distributor/dealer engagement * Coordinate trade fair participation, customer events, and regional marketing activations * Track, analyse, and report on marketing performance. Use data to optimise activity and demonstrate ROI Public Relations Department Management (Corporate Reputation & Crisis Control) * Global Corporate Reputation Management: Direct domestic and international media relations, press release approvals, and corporate communication strategies for major public events (e.g., investor conferences, shareholder meetings, international signing ceremonies). * Cross-Border Crisis PR Response Framework: Establish unified Crisis Management Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across parent and subsidiary companies, leading real-time incident response and public sentiment management for industrial safety, environmental, labour, or international trade disputes. * Stakeholder Communications: Oversee communication channels between parent/subsidiaries and government authorities, industry associations, investors, and the general public, safeguarding a strong, compliant corporate citizenship profiles. What We Are Looking For Professional Experience * Education: Master’s degree or MBA in Management, International Business, Finance, or Business Administration from an accredited domestic or international university preferred. * Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in strategic planning and investment staff roles within large multinational corporations or publicly listed companies, including at least 10 years of executive leadership experience managing brand marketing and public relations functions. Competencies & Leadership * Multinational Group Governance: Thorough understanding of holding company structures and parent-subsidiary governance models, with hands-on executive experience overseeing overseas entities (e.g., Southeast Asia, Mainland China, or other international locations). * Commercial Acumen & Investment Acuity: Strong financial acumen with sharp analytical skills to identify commercial opportunities and evaluate investment risks in domestic and overseas infrastructure, clean energy, and power transmission markets. * Executive PR & Brand Foresight: High sensitivity to media dynamics and executive-level crisis response capabilities, capable of navigating geopolitical and market volatility risks to safeguard corporate reputations. * Global Communication Proficiency: Fluent in professional business English (and proficiency in local languages of overseas subsidiaries is an advantage) across listening, speaking, reading, and writing; fully capable of negotiating and aligning with global executives, international media, and strategic partners. * Transformational Leadership: Proven resilience and change-management leadership within traditional manufacturing transformation contexts, demonstrating the ability to guide and align cross-functional, multicultural teams across strategy, marketing, and public relations

new_jobs.title: Director, Site Start Up
new_jobs.jd: Precision for Medicine is a Clinical Research Organization. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas. Due to our continued growth we are seeking a **Director, Site Start Up** **Position Summary** Provides leadership to the Site Start-up (SSU) department. Contributes to the strategy and direction of the implementation and expansion of the SSU department in terms of people, processes and systems. Collaborates with other functions to secure SSU delivery and client satisfaction on SSU activities (typically, these include activities such as Informed Consent Form review and adaptation, Regulatory Document collection and quality review, Support to Regulatory and sites on IRB/EC/CA submissions and support to Site Contracts group in budget and contract negotiation). Works closely with the Head of Site Start Up on the ongoing development of SSU . Ensures the conduct and delivery of clinical trials in compliance with Regulatory requirements (local and regional), ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practices (ICH) and SOPs. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: * Provides SSU team with guidance, leadership and overall support relating to SSU project delivery, communication, human resources, revenue enhancement, procedures, systems and processes to meet client and departmental targets. * Supports the overall management of site start up delivery either by direct management and/or cross functional oversight of the depts involved in the different areas of site start-up (Local/Central IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) submissions, Competent Authorities (CA) submissions, other related governing organizations/bodies, site contracts and budget negotiations and any other start up requirements). * Works closely with the Head of Site Start Up to establish the Precision for Medicine (PFM) SSU framework to ensure project execution and delivery including SSU intelligence, tools and methodology, risk evaluations and mitigations. * Supports SSU collaboration with Clinical Operations team, project management and other relevant cross functional departments in the planning, execution and governance of SSU activities globally and/or regionally * Works with the Head of Site Start Up to support defined corporate and departmental business strategies for PfM * Acts as an ambassador for change management for evolution of global structure for PFM growth and expansion * Provide leadership and oversight on SSU programs including large programs or programs that are increasingly complex (in scope, revenue contribution, volume and design) * Manage escalations and remediation of SSU concerns timely and effectively * Supports optimization of processes and delivery with the goal of contributing to the profitability of the SSU teams to meet or exceed budget targets * Partner with Global Resourcing teams for assessment and management of team members (SSU leads, SSU Specialist and Site Contract Management staff) to ensure that established cost, time, and quality goals are met * Supports SSU team career development, growth and succession planning activities. Ensures compliance with company policies and procedures and other applicable regulatory guidelines * Supports coordination of SSU Lead’s participation in current and prospective client meetings and presentations to ensure PfM customer service is well represented * Collaborates with Business Development in opportunity development, proposals and budgeting, bid defense preparation and attendance for any SSU participants * Works with global/regional functional leaders to support SSU project strategy and SSU delivery * Supports SSU evaluations and implements required changes for all projects * Develop, measure and report SSU KPIs and lead continuous improvement * Recognize, exemplify, and adhere to PFM’s values that center on our commitment to quality, our people, clients and performance * Leverage communication skills and experience to reinforce PfM culture and values to motivate, maintain engagement and drive retention for SSU team **Requirement** * Bachelors degree in life sciences or related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. * A minimum of 12 years in clinical research including extensive experience of Site Start-up * Extensive leadership experience or proven competencies for this position. * Expert knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process. **Other Required** * Demonstrated leadership track record * Experience working in team environment with resource management experience * Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and clinical software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC etc) * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting * Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor * Proven experience in strategic planning, risk management and change management * Fluency in English. new_jobs.title: Solution Architect (GenAI)
new_jobs.jd: **About the Role** Going Cloud partners with leading enterprises in financial services, e-commerce, and manufacturing to turn GenAI ambition into production systems on AWS. We're looking for a Senior Solutions Architect who can embed deeply within a large organization and become its trusted technical advisor. You'll need to understand not just the architecture, but also the people, priorities, and decision dynamics behind it. This role suits someone who thrives when requirements are ambiguous and change quickly. On a given day you might shape direction with executives, unblock engineering teams, and get a design through review by the client's risk, compliance, and security teams. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the lead technical advisor for a strategic enterprise account, building long-term trust with executives, IT leaders, and business owners. * Understand the client's organization, including key stakeholders, decision-makers, competing priorities, and approval processes. Use that understanding to align initiatives and keep programs moving. * Lead discovery and solution design for AI and cloud initiatives, covering business framing, architecture, PoC, production rollout, and scale-out. * Design cloud architectures that meet each client's requirements for security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory compliance. * Adapt quickly as client needs evolve, adjusting priorities while keeping stakeholders aligned on value and trade-offs. * Present solutions to client stakeholders and win their buy-in by communicating complex ideas and concepts in a clear, compelling way. * Work closely with internal delivery and sales teams to ensure solutions are implemented as designed. * Keep up with AWS and GenAI developments and turn them into reusable assets, reference architectures, and recommendations. ﻿ **Requirements** * 8+ years of experience in one or more technology domains, such as software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, or data & analytics. * 3+ years of client-facing experience working with executives, technical teams, or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies. * Hands-on experience delivering GenAI solutions that create real business value, taking them from PoC into production. This may include integrating LLMs or multimodal foundation models into production systems, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows, prompt and context engineering, foundation model evaluation, and LLMOps. * Working knowledge of cloud architecture fundamentals, including networking, security, identity, data, and compute. * Strong communication and proposal skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences and build credibility with senior stakeholders. * Strong business acumen, including an understanding of how clients create value, how budgets are decided, and how to build a business case for an initiative. * Track record of quickly learning new technologies and applying them to client problems, especially in fast-moving areas such as GenAI. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep cloud architecture expertise across networking, security, identity, data, and compute, with a track record of designing large-scale, production-grade environments. * Deep hands-on AWS experience, for example with Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, and secure private-network architectures. AWS Professional-level certifications are a plus. * Experience delivering in financial services or other regulated industries. * Excellent presentation skills, including presenting to C-level audiences or speaking at industry events. * Strong time management, balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders without dropping commitments. * Ability to communicate in English.

Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. Additionally, the role includes creating scalable and robust LLM/RAG frameworks tailored to customer service scheduling, fostering innovation and maintaining a competitive market edge. **This role is 100% Remote, Work from Home based.** **Responsibilities** * Own the full LLM pipeline from data preparation to production real case usage. * Design, iterate and optimize prompts (zero-/few-shot, chain-of-thought, tool-calling, etc.) to maximize model utility and safety across products and languages. * Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) QA/search systems that connect to multi-source knowledge bases. * Familiar with vLLM/SGLang inference architectures and have proven experience deploying and operating LLM services on multi‑GPU or cluster environments. * Design, implement and operate multi‑agent LLM architectures (e.g. LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) including task decomposition, agent orchestration, memory sharing and tool‑calling workflows. * Develop evaluation pipelines (automatic metrics & human feedback) to measure prompt and model quality, bias, and hallucination rates. * Collaborate with product and CS teams to integrate AI models into conversational Chatbot in different scenarios. * Track cutting-edge research, author tech blogs, and keep improve current architecture. **Requirements** * Master’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science or related field.. * At least 2 years of deep-learning/NLP experience, including 1+ year practical LLM work (SFT, DPO, RAG, quantization, inference optimization, etc.). * Demonstrated prompt engineering & tuning expertise (few-shot design, structured prompting, prefix-/p-tuning, reward re-ranking, safety filtering). * Practical experience building and deploying multi‑agent LLM workflows, with understanding of agent‑orchestrator patterns, shared memory, long‑horizon planning and guard‑rail design. * Proficient in both English and Chinese communication for efficient cross team collaboration **Why Binance** * Shape the future of finance * Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure * Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy * Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning * Competitive salary and company benefits * success. **Your Mission** * Leverage AI-native development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across every stage of the development lifecycle to deliver stable, high-quality output new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
new_jobs.jd: Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer-scale transistors to micron-level die-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient. **Job Duties** **Job Summary & Responsibilities** * Demonstrated knowledge of strategic sourcing, category management, and supplier relationship management * Responsible for developing and implementing Strategic Sourcing strategies for assigned Commodities including: + Assess Current & Future Requirements: Need to map direct and indirect requirements and work with cross functional teams such as engineering to create full understanding of the market and competitive landscape. + Subject matter expert of the commodity: Identify multiple potential suppliers who can meet our requirements. Assess their reliability, reputation, financial stability, production capacity, quality control, and their ability to meet our product and operational requirements. + Commercial Approach: Negotiate long-term contracts with selected suppliers to provide stability and assurance of supply. Contracts should clearly define quality standards, delivery schedules, pricing and business continuity planning or any contingencies in case of supply disruptions or changes. + Responsible for managing schedule and task details by utilizing project management tools such as reports, tracking charts, checklist and project scheduling software. + Ensure all key suppliers have executed Supply Master Agreements, and are completing monthly scorecards + Ensure that the supply base is capable and has the capacity to handle our volume requirements, including the ability to handle surge requirements. + Manage long-term partnerships by implementing supplier development strategies that provide greater capabilities to Onto Innovation and provides plans for reductions in cost and lead times. * Engage key business stakeholders and be actively involved in Operations strategic planning, supplier development, and field service improvements. + Lead internal Onto Commodity Council with key stakeholders for assigned responsibilities. + Drive strategic procurement initiatives to optimize supply, risk mitigation and flexibility, quality improvement, and improvements in lead time and cost. + Analyze existing processes and communications with suppliers to improve the information communicated to and from suppliers and summarizes actions to be taken between organizations. + Provide oversight of procurement related activities for suppliers directly responsible + Be actively engaged in the development and execution of ECO’s with the supply base and be proactive in managing sourcing strategies for end of life components. + Ensure the supply base is properly managing and executing Supplier Quality Actions, discrepant materials, return to vendor transactions, and repair/refurbishment that are in or out of warranty. + Responsible for managing schedule and task details by utilizing project management tools such as reports, tracking charts, checklist and project scheduling software. + Coordinate and lead QBR with Key Suppliers for assigned Commodities. * Develop short & long-term strategies using market analysis, user requirements, and company objectives for assigned commodities. + The position requires an understanding of quantitative techniques relevant to sourcing functions (i.e., TCO modelling, “should cost” analysis, RFP analysis, negotiation evaluation, and financial modelling). + Identify make vs. buy opportunities and drive alignment/decision with key stakeholders. + Drive the evaluation of supplier performance. Collaborate effectively with leadership at suppliers to address sourcing issues + Ensure decision making and prioritization processes are in place and utilized + Negotiate and formalize supplier agreements which require knowledge of the various contractual vehicles that are available. * Responsible for developing and implementing a Sourcing/Operations strategy for New Product introduction + Collaborates with engineering team to understand engineering requirements and communicate to supplier in a cohesive manner. + Works with engineering to identify preliminary critical parts, long-lead parts and inspection requirements. Assists and/ or leads in developing supplier and commodity road maps to engineering. Utilizes value analysis on build-to-print components in support of Should Cost analysis. + Ensure that product lifecycle programs (PLC) are meeting material cost targets and Gross Margin targets; facilitate and maintain Cost Apportionment Models + Provides engineering and business process expertise to team and other members on various significantly complex programs/issues. **Qualifications** **Desired Skills and Experience** * BA in business or other quantitative field, or comparable experience. * Minimum of 10+ years of operational experience with at least 5 years being in a successful Supply Chain management role. * Good working knowledge of ERP systems, and understands the roles of Master Scheduling, Material Planning and Procurement. * Able to establish relationships and trust within the organization and the supply base. new_jobs.jd: Please apply through our website directly to be reviewed: 2027 Taiwan Campus Hiring | Procter & Gamble As a Product Supply Manager, you will be at the intersection of business strategy and supply chain execution, driving business growth through smart, data-driven decisions. You will ensure products are available to consumers when and where they need them, while optimizing service, cost, inventory, and profitability. Unlike traditional supply chain roles, Product Supply professionals are business leaders who own critical decisions that directly impact sales, customer satisfaction, and business results. From Day One, you will take ownership of meaningful projects and collaborate with multifunctional teams to solve complex business challenges. **Build End-to-End Expertise Through Rotations** Early in your career, you will participate in our rotational development program, taking on new assignments every 2 to 3 years based on your strengths, interests, and business needs. Demand Planning:** * Partner with Sales, Marketing, Supply Planning, and Logistics teams to develop demand forecasts and business plans. * Lead the integrated Business Operations Planning (BOP) process to improve forecast accuracy, drive growth, and enhance operational performance. **2. Customer Supply Chain:** * Collaborate with key customers to understand their supply chain needs and improve product availability, responsiveness, and efficiency across the joint supply network. * Drive initiatives that create value for both customers and consumers. **3. Operation:** * Manage warehousing and third-party logistics (3PL) operations to ensure excellent service, operational efficiency, and product quality. * Optimize the movement of goods from distribution centers to customers while balancing cost and service objectives. Whether managing information flows, planning product availability, optimizing customer supply networks, or leading operational improvements, you will play an essential role in delivering superior products to consumers while driving sustainable business growth. Ready to make an impact from Day One? Join us and help shape the future of our business! Requirement: * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Ability to extract insights from data and translate them into business actions. * Demonstrated leadership, ownership, and collaboration skills. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. * Passion for driving business growth through operational excellence. * Proficiency in English (written and spoken) * Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data analytics, or digital tools is a plus. * Legally eligible to work in Taiwan.
